title: (web) Score view needs an Export DAW set action using the serve route
description:
## Intent

(web) The Score view needs a way to export the open score as a DAW set. Filed for the web/docs session; this task states the need only, not the visuals.

## The need

- An action on a saved score that calls `GET /export/daw-set/{scoreId}` on the local server with the library's API key and saves the zip.
- Show the located problems from a `422` the way compile problems are shown (line and column), and the warnings header's items after a successful export.
- Only when the app runs against a local library (`custom.apricity.mode == "local"` in `amplify_outputs.json`); in cloud mode, hide or explain it (see the open question on the initiative).
- Unsaved edits: export what is saved, or ask to save first (web session decides).

## Verification

`npm --prefix web run build`; the web session's own browser test for the action; manual: export from the app, open in the DAW.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): export a DAW set from the Score view` (web session).

## Depends on

The export route task in this epic.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Superseded in approach by M6 (apricitus-0656bd): the Score view's action should call the browser-side export, not the serve route. Keep this task for the local-mode fallback only if M6's page path cannot ship first; otherwise close it when M6's web task lands.
